_howto: Elections polled by the Maryland State Board of Elections adapter (server/src/adapters/mdsbe.js). base = the results folder (election night 2026: results.elections.maryland.gov/elections/2026/General_results, where elections.maryland.gov redirects; the old elections.maryland.gov/.../general_results copy stopped at 4:24 PM); the adapter reads gen_results_{year}_1.html (its 'Last refreshed' line is the change check) and gen_results_{year}_by_county_{1..countyPages}.html (every contest, per county). multiCounty = regex on a contest's office heading (<h2>) for offices that span several counties and are summed across them; any other contest is kept per county. utcOffset = the offset of the pages' Eastern times on election day. Set enabled:false to stop polling.
_fipsHowto: countyFips: county page names matched by FIPS instead of by name (us-atlas names both Baltimore County 24005 and Baltimore City 24510 'Baltimore').
multiCounty: ^(governor|comptroller|attorney general|representative in congress|u\.?s\.? senator|united states senator|state senator|house of delegates|judge of the circuit court|judge, appellate court|judge, supreme court|judge, court of appeals|question \d+\b)
